note: Each case names the exact rows a correct implementation leaves behind: the rows that must be present with the column values that make them correct, and the rows that must be absent because their presence is the defect. Before PF-020 every case carried the same four generic interleaving steps and a one-line sentence, which described a scenario and asserted nothing a reader could check. `residual_rows` is what makes the plan falsifiable, and `scripts/repository/validate_p1140e_contracts.py` resolves every table and every column named here against `packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql`, so a renamed column breaks the plan rather than quietly outliving it. These are plans. None has been executed: `execution_state` is `planned-runtime-evidence` on every case and no PostgreSQL instance in this repository has run one.
